title: Sprint error messages truncated in console output
source_context: JustFacts sprint 2026-07-05, 4 parallel Morty's all failed on a transient connection error and were blocked without retry
description: During a DAG sprint, agent failures were shown as 'API Error: Co' (truncated at ~15 chars). Full reason ('Connection closed mid-response') was only recoverable from .cto/logs/*.jsonl. Console should show the full (or at least 120-char) failure reason. Also consider auto-retry once on transient stream/connection errors before marking tickets blocked.
proposed_changes: Widen truncation in sprint status rendering; wrap agent invocation with 1 retry on 'Connection closed mid-response'

triage.evidence: scripts/orchestrate.py:514 captures `str(e)[:500]` into result but line 539 prints only `result['status']` — failure reason never shown for parallel DAG tickets; line 1810 renders blocked notes as `note[:40]`, line 1139 as `reason[:80]`. Grep for retry/Connection closed/transient across orchestrate.py, delegate.py, workers.py, sleepy.py matches only reformat-retry (delegate.py:1972) and reflection-retry (delegate.py:3147) — no connection-error retry. git log: last commit on orchestrate.py is c09b11b (2026-07-03), before proposal creation 2026-07-05; ledger.json has only the self-reported entry, never applied.
triage.note: Both halves of the proposal are still unaddressed: DAG-phase failures print only the bare status word with the captured error reason discarded, and there is no retry on transient connection errors anywhere in the delegation path. orchestrate.py has not been committed to since before the proposal was filed. Fix is contained in orchestrate.py (widen/print failure reason in _run_dag_phases and blocked rendering; wrap _dag_delegate with one retry on connection-type errors), does not touch prometheus.py. Retry half carries mild risk since delegation is not idempotent — retry should only fire when no ticket state was mutated.
